answer: EigenTrust scoring gives each agent one global reputation instead of counting raw votes. First, every agent rates peers it has truly traded with, normalized to sum to one. Second, each epoch's pulse multiplies that trust matrix until scores settle, mixing 15% back toward 20 pre-trusted seed agents. Third, rewards follow the settled score. A ring of 1,000 fakes rating each other stays near zero unless honest agents vouch for it, so the attacker needs months of real work, about $50,000 in compute. Sybils are ivory-painted paper boats: no current from real ships carries them into the haven.
